description: The people in a Slack workspace the Hermoso app is in: member id, @name, full name, display name and title. Bots, apps and deactivated accounts are left out, and no email address is read. Use it to find who to message before send_slack_dm; `query` takes part of a name. Needs the Hermoso app in the Slack workspace with its direct-message permissions: a workspace that added the app before 2026-11-15 adds it again once under Connectors > Slack (the tool says so). Free.

brand.description: WHICH PROFILE the post lives in — id or exact name from list_brands (a shared workspace: its profile id). Needed when it was published in a profile this connection is not pinned to; applies to THIS CALL ONLY. A name that matches no profile, or two, is REFUSED and nothing is done.

slackWorkspace.description: which workspace (id or name) when there are several
